CustomField.description: The AdaptAbility conversation session id that triggered this escalation. This is the idempotency key the escalation action upserts on (External ID, Unique), so a retried or duplicate escalation trigger within the same session updates this one Case instead of creating a second one.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically by the AdaptAbility escalation action. Do not edit manually.
CustomField.label: AdaptAbility Session Id
